rule: FINAL_APP_READY requires the approved cinematic and semantic presentation systems to be active on the modular six-surface app. Static surface parity alone is insufficient.

reference.architecture: presentation-only; no liturgical, data, or navigation ownership

bootCinematic.note: Cold-load boot cinematic still exists in the monolith, but remains owned by the legacy embedded presentation layer.

modularRouteTransitions.note: The modular six-surface shell calls the approved v43.12 transition owner on actual ribbon navigation. PR #176 passed visual, app and R17 convergence.

modularAsyncLoader.note: Slow modular surface navigation reuses the v43.12 delayed loader and suppresses it under reduced motion.

modularSurfaceEntry.note: Home, Mass, PRAY, Learn, Calendar and Settings receive geometry-neutral surface-entry choreography.

artLoading.note: V5 makes modular surface entry explicitly invoke the approved v43.12 scanArt owner instead of introducing a second shimmer/blur system. Existing Home Proper, Rosary, Saint and Stations imagery retain the canonical v43.12 image selectors. CI validation remains required.

verticalSemanticRails.note: PRAY restores geometry-neutral semantic icon rails without duplicating horizontal stage navigation. Angelus exposes resolved Stand/Kneel plus devotional context. Stations exposes sourced attention/context cues without inventing a universal posture. Adoration, Benediction and Confession expose canonical contextual identity. The external canonical Rosary player now has its own live mystery/context rail. PR #180 passed visual, app and R17 convergence.

heroPresenceAndEntryChoreography.note: V5 restores restrained prototype-level hero entry choreography to Home celebration identity, PRAY devotional heroes, Learn formation hero and Calendar Sacred Time. Background interaction rescans do not repeatedly restart existing hero motion; reduced motion suppresses it. CI validation is required.

reducedMotion.note: System and app reduced-motion preferences suppress non-essential FX.

rosaryLiveFx.note: The preserved canonical Rosary player receives a geometry-neutral right context rail from AO_ROSARY_V381 state and reuses AO_CINEMATIC_V4312 only when a new mystery is entered. No universal Rosary posture is invented, bead navigation is untouched, reduced motion suppresses the cinematic, and PR #183 passed Visual acceptance, App convergence and R17 convergence.

stationsLiveFx.note: Stations uses the canonical look/attention cue, XIV-step context rail and restrained transition cinematic on actual station changes. It deliberately does not impose a universal kneel/stand track. PR #188 passed visual, app and R17 convergence.

nextRecoveryTargets: phone-certify V5 modular hero choreography and single-owner v43.12 art scanning
extract the v43.12 cinematic owner from monolithic index.html into a modular presentation owner without changing behavior
close PRESENTATION_FX_PARITY only after extracted boot/transition/loader/art behavior passes the same production phone gates
